subject.title: fix(infra): add NaN guard for unparseable timestamps from external inputs

question: Should this PR keep the compaction-boundary and session-tree timestamp semantics, or should those hunks defer to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99501 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97126?
rationale: The provider reset guards are mechanical, but the session-state hunks overlap active proof-positive work that defines malformed persisted timestamp behavior.

options.title: Defer Session Semantics
options.body: Keep this PR focused on provider/auth timestamp guards and leave compaction and persisted session timestamp policy to the canonical session PRs.

options.title: Accept This Scope
options.body: Keep the session hunks here only if maintainers explicitly accept the invalid-boundary fallback and sorting behavior in this broader PR.

options.title: Pause Behind Session PRs
options.body: Hold this PR until the compaction and persisted timestamp candidates resolve which session-state changes remain necessary.

recommendation.title: Defer Session Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this PR focused on provider/auth timestamp guards and leave compaction and persisted session timestamp policy to the canonical session PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is about session/compaction semantics, and recent session seam history makes this the best available routing candidate.
